description:
SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 is a government welfare scheme launched by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare in India.

The scheme was officially launched on October 5, 2021.

It is a part of the larger initiative to strengthen the Krishi Vigyan Kendras or KVKs across the country.

The primary objective of SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 is to enhance the capacity and capability of KVKs to provide better services to farmers.

The scheme aims to improve the agricultural productivity and income of farmers through various interventions.

One of the measurable targets of the scheme is to increase the average income of farmers by 50 percent by the year 2025.

The scheme also focuses on promoting sustainable agricultural practices and enhancing food security.

Under SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0, the government plans to establish 750 new KVKs across the country.

These KVKs will be equipped with modern facilities and technologies to provide training and support to farmers.

The benefits of the scheme include access to training programs, workshops, and demonstrations on advanced agricultural techniques.

Farmers will receive assistance in the form of financial support for adopting new technologies and practices.

The scheme allocates a budget of INR 1,500 crores for the implementation of various activities under SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0.

Eligibility criteria for farmers to benefit from the scheme include being a resident of India and actively engaged in agricultural activities.

There are no specific age limits set for eligibility under this scheme.

Farmers must demonstrate a willingness to adopt innovative agricultural practices to qualify for assistance.

The application process for SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 involves several steps.

Farmers need to approach their nearest KVK to express their interest in the scheme.

They must fill out an application form provided by the KVK.

Required documents include proof of identity, land ownership documents, and any relevant agricultural training certificates.

Once the application is submitted, KVK officials will review the applications and conduct a field assessment.

Farmers will be informed about their eligibility and the next steps in the process.

The scheme has a timeline for implementation that spans from 2021 to 2025.

Disbursement of financial assistance will occur in phases based on the progress of activities undertaken by the farmers.

The implementing authority for SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 is the Indian Council of Agricultural Research or ICAR.

ICAR is responsible for overseeing the functioning of KVKs and ensuring the effective implementation of the scheme.

Each KVK will have a dedicated team of experts to provide guidance and support to farmers.

The scheme also emphasizes the use of digital technology in agriculture.

Farmers will be trained on using mobile applications for better crop management and market access.

The government aims to reach approximately 10 million farmers through this initiative.

Regular monitoring and evaluation will be conducted to assess the impact of the scheme on farmers' livelihoods.

The scheme also promotes the use of organic farming practices.

Farmers will be educated on the benefits of organic fertilizers and pest management techniques.

SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 encourages the formation of farmer producer organizations or FPOs.

These organizations will help farmers in collective marketing and better price realization for their produce.

The scheme also includes provisions for skill development and entrepreneurship training for rural youth.

This aims to create employment opportunities in the agricultural sector.

The government plans to collaborate with various stakeholders including NGOs and private sector players.

This collaboration will enhance the outreach and effectiveness of the scheme.

Farmers will also receive guidance on accessing credit and financial services.

The scheme aims to reduce the dependency of farmers on traditional practices.

It encourages the adoption of modern agricultural technologies.

The initiative is expected to contribute significantly to the overall growth of the agricultural sector in India.

The government has set up a dedicated helpline for farmers to address their queries regarding the scheme.

Farmers can call the helpline for assistance with the application process and other related inquiries.

The scheme is aligned with the government's vision of doubling farmers' income by 2022.

It also supports the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations.

The implementation of SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 is expected to lead to increased agricultural productivity.

This will ultimately enhance food security and improve the standard of living for rural households.

The scheme is a crucial step towards transforming the agricultural landscape in India.

The government is committed to providing continuous support and resources to farmers under this initiative.

SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 represents a holistic approach to agricultural development.

It integrates various aspects of farming including technology, training, and financial support.

The scheme is designed to be inclusive and accessible to all farmers across the country.

It aims to empower farmers with knowledge and resources to make informed decisions.

The government encourages farmers to actively participate in the training programs offered under the scheme.

By doing so, they can gain valuable insights into modern farming practices.

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in rural economies.

As farmers improve their productivity and income, it will lead to enhanced economic stability in rural areas.

The government will continue to monitor the progress of SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0.

This will ensure that the objectives of the scheme are met effectively.

The initiative is a testament to the government's commitment to the agricultural sector.

It reflects the importance of agriculture in the overall development of the country.

Farmers are encouraged to take full advantage of the opportunities presented by SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0.
